categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the distribution and retail of plastic raw materials, including engineering plastics and high-performance resins. It serves as the domestic agent for SABIC INNOVATIVE PLASTICS and trades with major global producers like INEOS STYROLUTION, BASF, POLYPLASTICS, DSM, TRINSEO, and SIBUR. Additionally, it produces ABS resin through compounding activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes extrusion and injection molding technologies for ABS resin production, employing automated extrusion lines and quality control systems including color and physical property inspections. It emphasizes advanced plastic molding technologies such as high-speed precision injection molding and collaborates on product development with customers to meet high-value-added product demands.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in the automotive, electronics, and general industrial sectors requiring engineering plastics and high-performance resins. The company serves domestic plastic processing firms and targets markets in South Korea with exports mainly to China and Southeast Asia. End markets include electrical appliances, automotive parts, and general industrial applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within South Korea, with headquarters in Incheon and branch offices in Miryang, Daegu, and Busan to cover the entire domestic market. It also engages in export activities focused on China and Southeast Asian countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions as a midstream distributor and compounder in the plastic materials supply chain, sourcing raw materials from global producers and supplying processed resins and compounds to plastic product manufacturers. It also participates in some downstream production through ABS resin compounding.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding domestic sales networks, acquiring additional distribution rights (notably from SABIC INNOVATIVE PLASTICS Korea), and developing new high-value-added products incorporating advanced technologies. The company focuses on innovation in eco-friendly materials, electric vehicle battery components, and high-performance plastics to respond to evolving market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through wholesale and retail sales of engineering plastics and high-performance resin products. The company also earns income from ABS resin production and compounding, with minor revenue from rental activities. Sales are conducted via direct orders and ongoing customer relationships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major domestic chemical producers and distributors such as LG Chem, Lotte Chemical, SK Chemicals, and Kumho Petrochemical. It holds a strong position as a specialized distributor and compounder in the Korean engineering plastics market, leveraging partnerships with global suppliers to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenues of approximately 36.1 billion KRW in the latest fiscal year, showing a 29% increase from the prior year. Operating profit increased by 52%, and net income grew by 68%, reflecting strong financial health with low debt ratios and high liquidity. The company has demonstrated steady growth despite market uncertainties.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality product supply with competitive pricing, supported by strong technical service and customer collaboration from product development through delivery. Its role as a domestic agent for leading global plastic producers and its ABS compounding capability provide differentiated value in meeting specialized customer needs for advanced engineering plastics.
